SELECT i.institution_name, ROUND(cs.net_capital * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets, 4) AS capital_adequacy_ratio
FROM capital_snapshot cs
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE cs.risk_weighted_assets > 0
ORDER BY capital_adequacy_ratio ASC, i.institution_name;

SELECT rc.loan_id, ds.principal_overdue_days, cg.grade_name_zh, rc.as_of_date
FROM risk_classification rc
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ds.loan_id = rc.loan_id AND ds.as_of_date = rc.as_of_date
JOIN classification_grade cg ON cg.grade_code = rc.grade_code
WHERE ds.principal_overdue_days > 90
  AND cg.grade_name_zh IN ('正常', '关注')
  AND rc.as_of_date = (
      SELECT MAX(rc2.as_of_date)
      FROM risk_classification rc2
      WHERE rc2.loan_id = rc.loan_id
  )
ORDER BY ds.principal_overdue_days DESC, rc.loan_id;

SELECT i.institution_name, ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS insufficient_provision_balance
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN provision_snapshot ps ON ps.loan_id = ld.loan_id AND ps.as_of_date = lbs.as_of_date
JOIN classification_grade cg ON cg.grade_code = (
    SELECT rc.grade_code
    FROM risk_classification rc
    WHERE rc.loan_id = ld.loan_id AND rc.as_of_date = lbs.as_of_date
    ORDER BY rc.as_of_date DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
WHERE cg.is_nonperforming = 1
  AND ps.required_amount > ps.recognized_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(lbs.principal_balance) > 100000000
ORDER BY insufficient_provision_balance DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT pi.instruction_id, pi.loan_id, p.display_name, is.sector_name_zh, pi.instruction_amount
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = pi.loan_id
JOIN account acc ON acc.account_id = ld.disbursement_account_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON ah.account_id = acc.account_id AND ah.effective_to IS NULL
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ah.party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN industry_sector is ON is.sector_code = op.industry_code
WHERE pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
  AND is.risk_category IN ('限制类', '退出类')
ORDER BY pi.instruction_amount DESC, pi.instruction_id;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ma.asset_category_secondary IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT') THEN pi.instruction_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS non_compliant_amount,
       ROUND(SUM(pi.instruction_amount), 2) AS total_amount,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ma.asset_category_secondary IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT') THEN pi.instruction_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(pi.instruction_amount), 6) AS ratio
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = pi.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN industry_sector ma ON ma.sector_code = op.industry_code
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY ratio DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT wp.product_id, wp.product_name, ma.asset_id, ma.maturity_on AS asset_maturity, wp.actual_termination_on AS product_termination
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON ma.asset_id = phs.asset_id
WHERE ma.maturity_on > wp.actual_termination_on
ORDER BY ma.maturity_on DESC;

SELECT 
    g.guarantor_party_id AS party_id,
    p.display_name AS party_name,
    COUNT(*) AS guarantee_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) 
     FROM credit_agreement ca2 
     WHERE ca2.borrower_party_id = g.guarantor_party_id) AS borrower_agreement_count
FROM guarantor_commitment g
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = g.guarantor_party_id
WHERE g.guarantor_party_id IN (SELECT borrower_party_id FROM credit_agreement)
GROUP BY g.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
ORDER BY guarantee_count DESC, g.guarantor_party_id;

SELECT pe.payment_id, pe.business_date, ptc.name_zh AS payment_type_name, pe.amount, ou.unit_name AS org_unit_name
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN payment_type_catalog ptc ON ptc.payment_type = pe.payment_type
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = pe.origin_org_unit_id
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
  AND pe.amount > 5000000
  AND pe.status = 'CLEARED'
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC, pe.payment_id;

SELECT ca.agreement_id, p.display_name AS borrower_name,
       is_sec.sector_name_zh AS borrower_industry,
       is_target.sector_name_zh AS target_industry,
       ca.contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN industry_sector is_sec ON is_sec.sector_code = op.industry_code
JOIN industry_sector is_target ON is_target.sector_code = ca.target_industry_code
WHERE op.industry_code != ca.target_industry_code
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC, ca.agreement_id;

SELECT pe.payment_id, pe.business_date, pe.amount, from_holder.party_id AS from_party_id, to_holder.party_id AS to_party_id
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account_holder ah_from ON ah_from.account_id = pe.from_account_id AND ah_from.effective_to IS NULL AND ah_from.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN account_holder ah_to ON ah_to.account_id = pe.to_account_id AND ah_to.effective_to IS NULL AND ah_to.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN party_relation pr ON (pr.source_party_id = ah_from.party_id AND pr.target_party_id = ah_to.party_id) OR (pr.source_party_id = ah_to.party_id AND pr.target_party_id = ah_from.party_id)
JOIN party from_holder ON from_holder.party_id = ah_from.party_id
JOIN party to_holder ON to_holder.party_id = ah_to.party_id
WHERE pe.is_cash = 0
  AND pe.status = 'CLEARED'
  AND pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC, pe.payment_id;

SELECT ca.agreement_id, p.display_name AS borrower_name, COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
ORDER BY loan_count DESC, ca.agreement_id;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
       ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS total_amount
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account a_from ON a_from.account_id = pe.from_account_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = a_from.institution_id
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
  AND pe.amount > 5000000
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50
ORDER BY total_amount DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT sm.staff_id, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN staff_member sm ON pe.operator_id = sm.staff_id
JOIN account acc ON pe.to_account_id = acc.account_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON acc.account_id = ah.account_id
JOIN party p ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN industry_sector isec ON op.industry_code = isec.sector_code
WHERE isec.sector_name_en IN ('Restricted', 'Exit')
GROUP BY sm.staff_id
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT cdd.record_id, i.institution_name, cdd.event_date, cdd.deadline_date,
       CAST(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(cdd.deadline_date) AS INTEGER) AS days_overdue
FROM customer_due_diligence_event_v3 cdd
JOIN institution i ON cdd.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE cdd.completion_date IS NULL
  AND cdd.event_date <= '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY days_overdue DESC, cdd.record_id
LIMIT 20;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id, 
    cl.collateral_id, 
    ca.status AS collateral_status, 
    sa.status AS security_status
FROM 
    security_agreement sa
JOIN 
    collateral_link cl ON cl.security_id = sa.security_id
JOIN 
    collateral_asset ca ON ca.collateral_id = cl.collateral_id
WHERE 
    ca.status = 'RELEASED' 
    AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY 
    sa.security_id;

SELECT ld.loan_id, ca.agreement_id, sa.security_id, so.covered_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN secured_obligation so ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN security_agreement sa ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
WHERE ld.status = 'WRITTEN_OFF'
  AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND (so.effective_to IS NULL OR so.effective_to > DATE('now'))
ORDER BY so.covered_amount DESC, ld.loan_id;

WITH loan_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        ld.loan_id,
        lbs.principal_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY i.institution_id 
            ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC, ld.loan_id ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM institution i
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs2 
        WHERE lbs2.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    )
),
ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_name,
        loan_id,
        principal_balance,
        rn,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY institution_id 
            ORDER BY principal_balance DESC
        ) AS balance_rank
    FROM loan_balances
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT 
    institution_name,
    loan_id,
    principal_balance,
    balance_rank
FROM ranked_loans
ORDER BY institution_name ASC;

WITH loan_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.industry_code,
        ld.loan_id,
        lbs.principal_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.industry_code ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC) AS rn
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM loan_balance_snapshot 
        WHERE loan_id = ld.loan_id
    )
),
top_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        industry_code,
        loan_id,
        principal_balance,
        rn
    FROM loan_balances
    WHERE rn <= 3
)
SELECT 
    sc.sector_name_zh AS industry_name,
    tl.loan_id,
    ROUND(tl.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    tl.rn AS rank_in_industry
FROM top_loans tl
JOIN industry_sector sc ON sc.sector_code = tl.industry_code
ORDER BY sc.sector_name_zh ASC, tl.rn ASC;

SELECT business_date,
       COUNT(*) AS daily_count,
       COUNT(*) - LAG(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY business_date) AS count_change
FROM payment_event
GROUP BY business_date
ORDER BY business_date;

SELECT i.institution_name, ld.loan_id, lbs.principal_balance,
       inst_avg.avg_balance,
       ROUND(lbs.principal_balance - inst_avg.avg_balance, 2) AS excess_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN institution i ON ld.agreement_id IN (
    SELECT ca.agreement_id FROM credit_agreement ca WHERE ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
)
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN (
    SELECT ca2.institution_id, AVG(lbs2.principal_balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld2
    JOIN credit_agreement ca2 ON ld2.agreement_id = ca2.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs2 ON ld2.loan_id = lbs2.loan_id
    GROUP BY ca2.institution_id
) inst_avg ON i.institution_id = inst_avg.institution_id
WHERE lbs.principal_balance > inst_avg.avg_balance
ORDER BY excess_amount DESC, ld.loan_id;

SELECT sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount, COUNT(gc.guarantor_party_id) AS guarantor_count
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
LEFT JOIN collateral_link cl ON cl.security_id = sa.security_id
GROUP BY sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
HAVING COUNT(cl.collateral_link_id) = 0
ORDER BY sa.secured_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN ds.principal_overdue_days = 0 THEN '0'
        WHEN ds.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN '1-30'
        WHEN ds.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 31 AND 90 THEN '31-90'
        WHEN ds.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 91 AND 180 THEN '91-180'
        WHEN ds.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 181 AND 360 THEN '181-360'
        ELSE '360 以上'
    END AS overdue_range,
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM delinquency_snapshot ds
WHERE ds.as_of_date = (
    SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
    FROM delinquency_snapshot
)
GROUP BY 
    CASE 
        WHEN ds.principal_overdue_days = 0 THEN 0
        WHEN ds.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN 1
        WHEN ds.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 31 AND 90 THEN 31
        WHEN ds.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 91 AND 180 THEN 91
        WHEN ds.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 181 AND 360 THEN 181
        ELSE 361
    END
ORDER BY 
    CASE 
        WHEN ds.principal_overdue_days = 0 THEN 0
        WHEN ds.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN 1
        WHEN ds.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 31 AND 90 THEN 31
        WHEN ds.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 91 AND 180 THEN 91
        WHEN ds.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 181 AND 360 THEN 181
        ELSE 361
    END;

SELECT collateral_id, valued_on, COUNT(*) AS duplicate_count
FROM collateral_valuation
GROUP BY collateral_id, valued_on
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY collateral_id;

WITH loan_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        p.party_id,
        COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal,
        AVG(lbs.principal_balance) AS avg_single_amount
    FROM party p
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    WHERE p.party_type = 'ORGANIZATION'
      AND lbs.as_of_date = (
          SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
          FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs2 
          WHERE lbs2.loan_id = ld.loan_id
      )
    GROUP BY p.party_id
)
SELECT 
    party_id,
    loan_count,
    ROUND(total_principal, 2) AS total_principal,
    ROUND(avg_single_amount, 2) AS avg_single_amount
FROM loan_stats
ORDER BY avg_single_amount DESC, party_id
LIMIT 5;

SELECT ou.unit_name, COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS staff_count, COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS transaction_count
FROM organization_unit ou
JOIN staff_member sm ON sm.home_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
JOIN payment_event pe ON pe.operator_id = (SELECT so.operator_id FROM service_operator so WHERE so.staff_id = sm.staff_id AND so.org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id LIMIT 1)
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, ou.unit_name
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    p.customer_segment,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count,
    ROUND(AVG(pp.annual_income), 2) AS avg_annual_income,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN pp.annual_income > 1000000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS high_income_ratio
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY p.customer_segment
ORDER BY p.customer_segment;

WITH inst_map AS (
    SELECT 
        pe.payment_id,
        COALESCE(ai.institution_id, ao.institution_id) AS institution_id,
        pe.amount,
        ah_src.party_id AS src_party_id,
        ah_dst.party_id AS dst_party_id
    FROM payment_event pe
    LEFT JOIN account acc_from ON acc_from.account_id = pe.from_account_id
    LEFT JOIN account acc_to ON acc_to.account_id = pe.to_account_id
    LEFT JOIN account_holder ah_src ON ah_src.account_id = pe.from_account_id AND ah_src.holder_role = 'OWNER'
    LEFT JOIN account_holder ah_dst ON ah_dst.account_id = pe.to_account_id AND ah_dst.holder_role = 'OWNER'
    LEFT JOIN institution ai ON ai.institution_id = acc_from.institution_id
    LEFT JOIN institution ao ON ao.institution_id = acc_to.institution_id
    WHERE pe.status = 'SUCCESS'
),
related_pairs AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT source_party_id, target_party_id
    FROM party_relation
    WHERE relation_type != 'NON_RELATED' AND effective_to IS NULL
),
filtered_tx AS (
    SELECT 
        im.institution_id,
        im.amount,
        CASE 
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM related_pairs rp 
                WHERE rp.source_party_id = im.src_party_id 
                  AND rp.target_party_id = im.dst_party_id
            ) THEN 1 
            ELSE 0 
        END AS is_related
    FROM inst_map im
    WHERE im.src_party_id IS NOT NULL AND im.dst_party_id IS NOT NULL
),
agg AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN is_related = 1 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS related_amount,
        SUM(amount) AS total_amount
    FROM filtered_tx
    GROUP BY institution_id
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(a.related_amount, 2) AS related_amount,
    ROUND(a.total_amount, 2) AS total_amount,
    ROUND(a.related_amount * 100.0 / a.total_amount, 2) AS ratio_pct
FROM agg a
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
WHERE a.total_amount > 0
ORDER BY ratio_pct DESC;

SELECT p.party_id, p.display_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) AS credit_card_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT td.account_id) AS term_deposit_count
FROM party p
JOIN payment_card pc ON pc.holder_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
JOIN term_deposit td ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN card_type_catalog ctc ON ctc.card_type = pc.card_type
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
  AND ctc.name_zh LIKE '%贷记卡%'
  AND a.account_kind = 'DEPOSIT'
  AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND pc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) > 0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT td.account_id) > 0
ORDER BY term_deposit_count DESC, p.party_id;

SELECT i.institution_name, AVG(CAST(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(ld.disbursed_on) AS REAL)) AS avg_loan_age_days
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY avg_loan_age_days DESC, i.institution_name;

WITH loan_balances AS (
    SELECT loan_id, principal_balance
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot)
),
ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT loan_id, principal_balance,
           NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY principal_balance DESC) AS quartile_group
    FROM loan_balances
)
SELECT loan_id, principal_balance, quartile_group
FROM ranked_loans
ORDER BY quartile_group ASC, principal_balance DESC, loan_id ASC
LIMIT 40;

WITH industry_balance AS (
    SELECT 
        i.sector_name_zh AS industry_name,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN industry_sector i ON i.sector_code = ca.target_industry_code
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY i.sector_name_zh
),
cumulative_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        industry_name,
        total_balance,
        SUM(total_balance) OVER (ORDER BY total_balance DESC) AS running_sum,
        SUM(total_balance) OVER () AS grand_total
    FROM industry_balance
)
SELECT 
    industry_name,
    ROUND(total_balance, 2) AS total_balance,
    ROUND(running_sum * 1.0 / grand_total, 4) AS cumulative_ratio
FROM cumulative_calc
WHERE running_sum * 1.0 / grand_total <= 0.8
ORDER BY cumulative_ratio ASC;

SELECT p.party_id, p.display_name, i.institution_name, COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
WHERE ld.status != 'CLOSED' AND ld.closed_on IS NULL
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name, i.institution_name, i.institution_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY loan_count DESC, p.party_id;

SELECT sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount, ca.collateral_id, cv.valuation_amount
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN collateral_link cl ON cl.security_id = sa.security_id
JOIN collateral_asset ca ON ca.collateral_id = cl.collateral_id
JOIN collateral_valuation cv ON cv.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE cv.valuation_amount > 2.0 * sa.secured_amount
  AND cv.valued_on = (
      SELECT MAX(cv2.valued_on)
      FROM collateral_valuation cv2
      WHERE cv2.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
  )
ORDER BY (cv.valuation_amount - sa.secured_amount) DESC, sa.security_id, ca.collateral_id, cv.valued_on;

SELECT p.party_id, p.display_name, COUNT(DISTINCT i.institution_id) AS institution_count
FROM party p
JOIN account_holder ah ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ah.account_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT i.institution_id) > 2
ORDER BY institution_count DESC, p.party_id;

SELECT to_account_id AS account_id, business_date AS transaction_date, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM payment_event
WHERE to_account_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY to_account_id, business_date
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, account_id, transaction_date
LIMIT 20;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count, ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS total_balance
FROM exposure_group_member egm
JOIN exposure_group eg ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = eg.institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id IN (
    SELECT ca.agreement_id
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
)
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_balance DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT g.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name, COUNT(*) AS guarantee_count,
       ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS total_guaranteed
FROM guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 AND SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) > 300000000
ORDER BY total_guaranteed DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
WHERE ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY i.institution_name
ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.overdue_since IS NOT NULL
  AND julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(lbs.overdue_since) >= 90
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id, 
    p.display_name AS borrower_name, 
    pi.instruction_amount, 
    pp.display_name AS payee_name
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN payment_instruction pi ON ld.loan_id = pi.loan_id
JOIN party p ON ld.agreement_id IS NOT NULL 
    AND p.party_id = (
        SELECT ca.borrower_party_id 
        FROM credit_agreement ca 
        WHERE ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    )
JOIN party pp ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
  AND pi.intended_payee_party_id = p.party_id
ORDER BY pi.instruction_amount DESC, ld.loan_id
LIMIT 200;

SELECT ca.agreement_id, p.display_name AS borrower_name, ca.contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN status_catalog sc ON sc.entity = 'party' AND sc.status_code = p.status
WHERE p.status = 'frozen'
  AND op.party_id IS NOT NULL
  AND ca.effective_to IS NULL
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC, ca.agreement_id;

SELECT ld.loan_id, lpc.product_name_zh, ld.target_industry_code, ld.disbursed_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN loan_product_catalog lpc ON lpc.product_code = ca.product_family
WHERE ld.status = 'NORMAL'
  AND lpc.is_working_capital = 1
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM industry_sector isc
      WHERE isc.sector_code = ld.target_industry_code
        AND isc.risk_category = 'EXIT'
  )
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC, ld.loan_id
LIMIT 200;

SELECT i.institution_name, l.loan_id, lbs.principal_balance, avg_stats.avg_balance,
       ROUND(lbs.principal_balance - avg_stats.avg_balance, 2) AS excess_amount
FROM loan_drawdown l
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = (
    SELECT ca.institution_id
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.agreement_id = l.agreement_id
)
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = l.loan_id
JOIN (
    SELECT ca.institution_id, AVG(lbs_inner.principal_balance) * 1.0 AS avg_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld_inner
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld_inner.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs_inner ON lbs_inner.loan_id = ld_inner.loan_id
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
) avg_stats ON avg_stats.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE lbs.principal_balance > avg_stats.avg_balance * 2
ORDER BY excess_amount DESC, l.loan_id;

WITH all_agreements AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_amount
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
    GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
),
non_related_agreements AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS non_related_amount
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
    JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM party_relation pr
        WHERE pr.source_party_id = p.party_id
          AND pr.relation_type != '非关联方'
    )
    GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
)
SELECT 
    aa.institution_name,
    COALESCE(nra.non_related_amount, 0.0) AS non_related_amount,
    aa.total_amount AS total_amount,
    ROUND(COALESCE(nra.non_related_amount, 0.0) * 1.0 / aa.total_amount * 100.0, 2) AS ratio_pct
FROM all_agreements aa
LEFT JOIN non_related_agreements nra ON nra.institution_id = aa.institution_id
ORDER BY ratio_pct DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS total_principal_balance,
    cs.net_capital,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 100.0 / cs.net_capital, 2) AS concentration_ratio
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND lbs.as_of_date = (
      SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
      FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs2 
      WHERE lbs2.loan_id = ld.loan_id
  )
  AND cs.as_of_date = (
      SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
      FROM capital_snapshot cs2 
      WHERE cs2.institution_id = i.institution_id
  )
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, p.party_id, p.display_name, cs.net_capital
HAVING SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 100.0 / cs.net_capital > 10
ORDER BY concentration_ratio DESC
LIMIT 200;

WITH industry_avg AS (
    SELECT ca.target_industry_code,
           AVG(ca.annual_interest_rate) AS avg_rate
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.target_industry_code IS NOT NULL
      AND ca.annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ca.target_industry_code
)
SELECT ca.agreement_id,
       p.display_name AS borrower_name,
       ROUND(ca.annual_interest_rate * 100, 2) AS exec_rate_pct,
       ROUND(ia.avg_rate * 100, 2) AS industry_avg_rate_pct,
       ROUND((ca.annual_interest_rate - ia.avg_rate) * 100.0 / ia.avg_rate, 2) AS markup_pct
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN industry_avg ia ON ia.target_industry_code = ca.target_industry_code
WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate > ia.avg_rate * 1.10
ORDER BY markup_pct DESC, ca.agreement_id;

SELECT i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lb.principal_balance * 1.0 / cs.net_capital > 0.1 THEN ca.borrower_party_id END) AS 超限客户数
FROM institution i
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lb ON lb.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE cs.as_of_date = (
    SELECT MAX(cs2.as_of_date)
    FROM capital_snapshot cs2
    WHERE cs2.institution_id = i.institution_id
)
AND lb.as_of_date = (
    SELECT MAX(lb2.as_of_date)
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lb2
    WHERE lb2.loan_id = ld.loan_id
)
AND ca.product_family = 'Corporate'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, cs.net_capital
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lb.principal_balance * 1.0 / cs.net_capital > 0.1 THEN ca.borrower_party_id END) > 0
ORDER BY 超限客户数 DESC;

WITH group_exposure AS (
    SELECT 
        eg.exposure_group_id,
        eg.group_name,
        i.institution_id,
        SUM(re.gross_exposure) AS total_exposure
    FROM exposure_group eg
    JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
    JOIN risk_exposure re ON re.obligor_party_id = egm.party_id AND re.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = re.agreement_id
    JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
    WHERE re.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM risk_exposure)
    GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, i.institution_id
),
capital_base AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM capital_snapshot)
)
SELECT 
    ge.exposure_group_id AS 集团编号，
    ge.group_name AS 集团名称，
    ROUND(ge.total_exposure, 2) AS 余额合计，
    ROUND(cb.net_capital, 2) AS 资本净额，
    ROUND(ge.total_exposure * 100.0 / cb.net_capital, 2) AS 占比
FROM group_exposure ge
JOIN capital_base cb ON cb.institution_id = ge.institution_id
WHERE ge.total_exposure * 100.0 / cb.net_capital > 10
ORDER BY 占比 DESC;

SELECT ca.agreement_id,
       ca.maturity_on,
       ld.loan_id,
       ld.status,
       ca.contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE ca.status = 'EXPIRED'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT ld.loan_id, ld.disbursement_account_id, ld.disbursed_on, pe.payment_id, pe.business_date, pe.amount,
       CAST(julianday(pe.business_date) - julianday(ld.disbursed_on) AS INTEGER) AS days_gap
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN payment_event pe ON pe.from_account_id = ld.disbursement_account_id
WHERE ld.disbursement_account_id IS NOT NULL
  AND pe.status = 'SETTLED'
  AND pe.business_date >= ld.disbursed_on
  AND CAST(julianday(pe.business_date) - julianday(ld.disbursed_on) AS INTEGER) <= 7
ORDER BY days_gap ASC, pe.amount DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

WITH loan_exposure AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        p.display_name AS customer_name,
        l.loan_id,
        lbs.principal_balance,
        cs.net_capital,
        (lbs.principal_balance * 1.0 / cs.net_capital) AS exposure_ratio
    FROM loan_drawdown l
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = l.agreement_id
    JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
    JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = l.loan_id
    JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM loan_balance_snapshot 
        WHERE loan_id = l.loan_id
    )
    AND cs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM capital_snapshot 
        WHERE institution_id = i.institution_id
    )
),
ranked_exposure AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_name,
        customer_name,
        exposure_ratio,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY institution_id ORDER BY exposure_ratio DESC) AS rn
    FROM loan_exposure
)
SELECT 
    institution_name,
    customer_name,
    exposure_ratio
FROM ranked_exposure
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY institution_name ASC;

WITH ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        l.loan_id,
        lb.principal_balance,
        l.institution_id, -- 假设 loan_drawdown 表中有 institution_id 或通过 agreement 关联获取，此处根据常见模型假设 loan_drawdown 可直接关联或需通过 agreement 关联 institution。
        -- 修正：根据 schema，loan_drawdown 没有直接的 institution_id，需要通过 credit_agreement -> institution_id 获取
        ca.institution_id,
        NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY ca.institution_id ORDER BY lb.principal_balance DESC) AS quartile
    FROM loan_drawdown l
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = l.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lb ON lb.loan_id = l.loan_id
    WHERE lb.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot lb2 WHERE lb2.loan_id = l.loan_id)
)
SELECT loan_id, principal_balance, quartile
FROM ranked_loans
ORDER BY quartile ASC, principal_balance DESC
LIMIT 300;

WITH inst_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_id,
        SUM(ld.principal_balance_after) AS total_principal
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs2 
        WHERE lbs2.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    )
    GROUP BY i.institution_id
)
SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    i.institution_name,
    lbs.principal_balance AS principal_balance,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance * 100.0 / it.total_principal, 2) AS ratio_pct
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN inst_totals it ON it.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (
    SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs2 
    WHERE lbs2.loan_id = ld.loan_id
)
ORDER BY i.institution_name ASC, ratio_pct DESC, ld.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT 
    l.loan_id,
    ROUND(l.disbursed_amount, 2) AS disbursed_amount,
    l.status AS loan_status,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(ls.overdue_principal), 0), 2) AS total_overdue_principal,
    COUNT(ls.loan_balance_id) AS overdue_count
FROM loan_drawdown l
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot ls ON l.loan_id = ls.loan_id
WHERE l.status = 'NORMAL'
  AND ls.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY l.loan_id, l.disbursed_amount, l.status
HAVING COUNT(ls.loan_balance_id) >= 2
ORDER BY overdue_count DESC, total_overdue_principal DESC, l.loan_id;

SELECT ld.loan_account_id, ld.disbursed_on, COUNT(*) AS loan_cnt
FROM loan_drawdown ld
GROUP BY ld.loan_account_id, ld.disbursed_on
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY loan_cnt DESC, ld.loan_account_id, ld.disbursed_on
LIMIT 200;

SELECT DISTINCT ah.party_id
FROM account_holder ah
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ah.account_id
JOIN term_deposit td ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = ah.party_id
WHERE ah.holder_role = 'OWNER'
ORDER BY ah.party_id;

SELECT s.person_party_id
FROM staff_member s
WHERE s.employment_status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM account_holder ah
    WHERE ah.party_id = s.person_party_id
  )
ORDER BY s.person_party_id;

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM payment_event pe
    WHERE (pe.from_account_id = a.account_id OR pe.to_account_id = a.account_id)
      AND pe.is_cash = 1
  )
ORDER BY a.account_id
LIMIT 300;

SELECT g.security_id, g.guaranteed_amount
FROM guarantor_commitment g
WHERE g.status = 'EXPIRED'
ORDER BY g.guaranteed_amount DESC, g.security_id;

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN julianday(ld.current_maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') < 0 THEN '已到期'
        WHEN julianday(ld.current_maturity_on) - julianday('!2026-06-30') <= 90 THEN '临期'
        ELSE '常态'
    END AS maturity_bucket,
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
WHERE ld.current_maturity_on IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY maturity_bucket
ORDER BY 
    CASE maturity_bucket
        WHEN '常态' THEN 1
        WHEN '临期' THEN 2
        WHEN '已到期' THEN 3
    END;

SELECT cl.collateral_id, COUNT(*) AS link_count
FROM collateral_link cl
JOIN security_agreement sa ON cl.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE cl.status = 'ACTIVE' AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY cl.collateral_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY link_count DESC, cl.collateral_id;

SELECT ca.collateral_type,
       ROUND(AVG(cv.valuation_amount), 2) AS avg_valuation,
       COUNT(*) AS valuation_count
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN collateral_valuation cv ON cv.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE cv.appraiser_kind = 'BANK_INTERNAL'
GROUP BY ca.collateral_type
ORDER BY avg_valuation DESC;

WITH acct_loan_cnt AS (
    SELECT repayment_account_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM loan_drawdown
    WHERE repayment_account_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY repayment_account_id
    HAVING cnt >= 3
),
ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT l.repayment_account_id, l.loan_id, l.disbursed_on, l.disbursed_amount,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.repayment_account_id ORDER BY l.disbursed_on, l.loan_id) AS rn
    FROM loan_drawdown l
    JOIN acct_loan_cnt a ON a.repayment_account_id = l.repayment_account_id
)
SELECT rl.repayment_account_id, rl.loan_id, rl.disbursed_on, rl.disbursed_amount, a.cnt
FROM ranked_loans rl
JOIN acct_loan_cnt a ON a.repayment_account_id = rl.repayment_account_id
WHERE rl.rn <= 2
ORDER BY rl.repayment_account_id, rl.disbursed_on;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.contract_amount,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) - ca.contract_amount AS excess_amount,
    COUNT(*) AS drawdown_count
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, ca.contract_amount
HAVING SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) > ca.contract_amount
ORDER BY ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
       COUNT(a.account_id) AS 账户数量,
       ROUND(SUM(abs.ledger_balance - abs.available_balance), 2) AS 差额合计
FROM account a
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
JOIN account_balance_snapshot abs ON abs.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE abs.ledger_balance > abs.available_balance
  AND (abs.ledger_balance - abs.available_balance) > 5000000
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 差额合计 DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT a.account_id, t.opening_principal, t.maturity_on, t.annual_interest_rate
FROM term_deposit t
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.maturity_on < '2026-06-30'
  AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY t.maturity_on, a.account_id;

SELECT card_id, card_type, issued_on
FROM payment_card
WHERE issued_on <= '2025-01-31'
  AND status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY issued_on, card_id;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) AS entrusted_total,
       SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'AUTONOMOUS' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) AS autonomous_total,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 4) AS entrusted_ratio
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING entrusted_ratio < 0.52
ORDER BY entrusted_ratio ASC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_amount,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.agreement_id) AS total_disbursed,
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount * 100.0 / SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.agreement_id), 2) AS single_pct
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
WHERE ld.status != 'CANCELLED'
GROUP BY ld.loan_id, ld.disbursed_amount, ca.agreement_id
HAVING single_pct > 90
ORDER BY ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    ROUND(SUM(wp.actual_raise_amount), 2) AS 实际募集合计,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = '在售' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS 计划募集合计,
    ROUND(SUM(wp.actual_raise_amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = '在售' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 0), 4) AS 完成率
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = wp.issuer_institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(wp.actual_raise_amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = '在售' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) > 1.2
ORDER BY 完成率 DESC, i.institution_name;

WITH loan_overdue_status AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.loan_id,
        cp.party_id AS borrower_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 
                FROM repayment_schedule rs 
                WHERE rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id 
                  AND rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
            ) THEN 1 
            ELSE 0 
        END AS has_overdue
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN credit_participant cp ON ca.agreement_id = cp.agreement_id 
        AND cp.participant_role = 'BORROWER'
    WHERE ld.status NOT IN ('CLOSED', 'CANCELLED')
),
borrower_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        borrower_id,
        SUM(has_overdue) AS overdue_loan_count,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loan_count
    FROM loan_overdue_status
    GROUP BY borrower_id
    HAVING SUM(has_overdue) > 0 
       AND (COUNT(*) - SUM(has_overdue)) > 0
)
SELECT 
    bs.borrower_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    bs.overdue_loan_count,
    bs.total_loan_count
FROM borrower_stats bs
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = bs.borrower_id
ORDER BY bs.overdue![]() DESC, bs.borrower_id ASC;

SELECT pi.instruction_id, ld.loan_id, bp.display_name AS borrower_name, 
       rp.display_name AS payee_name, pi.instruction_amount
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN party bp ON bp.party_id = ld.borrower_party_id
JOIN party rp ON rp.party_id = pi.intended_payee_party_id
WHERE pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
  AND pi.intended_payee_party_id != ld.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY pi.instruction_amount DESC, pi.instruction_id
LIMIT 300;

SELECT ld.loan_id, ld.disbursed_on, ca.agreement_id, ca.signed_on, ld.disbursed_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
WHERE ld.disbursed_on < ca.signed_on
ORDER BY ld.loan_id;

SELECT rs.loan_id, COUNT(*) AS unpaid_installments, ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS total_principal_due
FROM repayment_schedule rs
WHERE rs.loan_id IN (
    SELECT loan_id FROM repayment_schedule
    EXCEPT
    SELECT loan_id FROM repayment_schedule WHERE status = 'PAID'
)
GROUP BY rs.loan_id
ORDER BY total_principal_due DESC, rs.loan_id
LIMIT 200;

SELECT ld.loan_id,
       ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
       ROUND(lbs.overdue_principal, 2) AS overdue_principal
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE ld.status = 'WRITTEN_OFF'
  AND lbs.principal_balance > 10000000
ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC, ld.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT ld.loan_id, ld.disbursed_on, ld.disbursement_account_id, a.opened_on
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ld.disbursement_account_id
WHERE ld.disbursed_on < a.opened_on
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_on, ld.loan_id;

SELECT ld.loan_id, ld.disbursement_account_id, a.account_kind, ld.disbursed_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ld.disbursement_account_id
WHERE a.account_kind LIKE '%储蓄%'
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC, ld.loan_id;

SELECT ca.agreement_id, ca.security_type, ca.contract_amount, p.display_name AS borrower_name
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE ca.security_type = 'CREDIT' AND ca.contract_amount > 8000000
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC, ca.agreement_id;

WITH prod_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.institution_id,
        ca.product_family,
        AVG(ca.annual_interest_rate) AS avg_rate
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id, ca.product_family
),
linked_borrowers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT pr.source_party_id AS party_id
    FROM party_relation pr
    WHERE pr.relation_type != '非关联方'
)
SELECT 
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    lb.party_id AS customer_id,
    ROUND(ca.annual_interest_rate, 4) AS contract_rate,
    ROUND(pa.avg_rate, 4) AS avg_product_rate,
    ROUND(pa.avg_rate - ca.annual_interest_rate, 4) AS rate_gap
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN linked_borrowers lb ON ca.borrower_party_id = lb.party_id
JOIN prod_avg pa ON pa.institution_id = ca.institution_id AND pa.product_family = ca.product_family
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate < pa.avg_rate
ORDER BY rate_gap DESC, ca.agreement_id;

SELECT pr.source_party_id, pr.target_party_id, rt.relation_name_zh
FROM party_relation pr
JOIN relation_type_catalog rt ON rt.relation_type = pr.relation_type
JOIN loan_drawdown ld_src ON ld_src.agreement_id IN (
    SELECT ca.agreement_id
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = pr.source_party_id
)
JOIN loan_drawdown ld_tgt ON ld_tgt.agreement_id IN (
    SELECT ca.agreement_id
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = pr.target_party_id
)
WHERE pr.relation_type != 'NON_AFFILIATED'
ORDER BY rt.relation_name_zh, pr.relation_id;

SELECT 
    eg.group_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS 成员数，
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS 余额合计，
    cs.net_capital AS 资本净额，
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 4) AS 占比
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.institution_id = eg.institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = eg.institution_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (
    SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs2 
    WHERE lbs2.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
)
AND cs.as_of_date = (
    SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
    FROM capital_snapshot cs2 
    WHERE cs2.institution_id = cs.institution_id
)
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, cs.net_capital, cs.institution_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 2 
   AND (SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital) > 0.1
ORDER BY 占比 DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    payer_party.display_name AS 付款方姓名，
    payee_party.display_name AS 收款方姓名，
    COUNT(*) AS 转账笔数，
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS 转账金额合计
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account from_acc ON from_acc.account_id = pe.from_account_id
JOIN account_holder from_ah ON from_ah.account_id = from_acc.account_id 
    AND from_ah.effective_to IS NULL
JOIN party payer_party ON payer_party.party_id = from_ah.party_id
JOIN account to_acc ON to_acc.account_id = pe.to_account_id
JOIN account_holder to_ah ON to_ah.account_id = to_acc.account_id 
    AND to_ah.effective_to IS NULL
JOIN party payee_party ON payee_party.party_id = to_ah.party_id
JOIN party_relation pr ON 
    (pr.source_party_id = payer_party.party_id AND pr.target_party_id = payee_party.party_id)
    OR (pr.source_party_id = payee_party.party_id AND pr.target_party_id = payer_party.party_id)
WHERE pr.relation_type != '非关联方'
  AND pr.effective_to IS NULL
  AND pe.status = 'SUCCESS'
GROUP BY payer_party.party_id, payee_party.party_id, payer_party.display_name, payee_party.display_name
ORDER BY 转账金额合计 DESC, 付款方姓名, 收款方姓名;

SELECT wp.product_id, wp.product_name, ma.asset_name
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON ma.asset_id = phs.asset_id
WHERE wp.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND wp.risk_level = 'R5'
  AND phs.lookthrough_depth > 1
ORDER BY wp.product_id;

SELECT phs.product_id, COUNT(*) AS asset_count
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
WHERE phs.lookthrough_depth > 1
  AND phs.intermediary_party_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY phs.product_id
ORDER BY asset_count DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT ld.loan_id,
       lbs.principal_balance,
       MAX(julianday(lbs.as_of_date) - julianday(ldo.overdue_since)) AS max_overdue_days
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ldo ON ldo.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE lbs.principal_balance > 90000000
  AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY ld.loan_id, lbs.principal_balance
HAVING MAX(julianday(lbs.as_of_date) - julianday(ldo.overdue_since)) >= 200
ORDER BY max_overdue_days DESC, ld.loan_id;

SELECT eg.exposure_group_id AS 集团编号，eg.group_name AS 集团名称，
       COUNT(DISTINCT ca.institution_id) AS 涉及机构数，
       COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS 取得授信的成员数
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ca.institution_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 涉及机构数 DESC, eg.exposure_group_id;

SELECT 
    eg.exposure_group_id AS 集团编号，
    eg.group_name AS 集团名称，
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS 逾期成员数，
    ROUND(SUM(d.overdue_principal), 2) AS 逾期本金合计
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id IN (
    SELECT ca.agreement_id 
    FROM credit_agreement ca 
    WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
)
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot d ON d.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE d.principal_balance > 0 AND d.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name
ORDER BY 逾期本金合计 DESC, eg.exposure_group_id;

WITH borrower_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.borrower_party_id AS party_id,
        SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_loan_amount
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.status != 'CLOSED'
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
),
guarantor_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        gc.guarantor_party_id AS party_id,
        SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS total_guarantee_amount
    FROM guarantor_commitment gc
    JOIN security_agreement sa ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id
    WHERE gc.status != 'CLOSED' AND sa.status != 'CLOSED'
    GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id
)
SELECT 
    p.display_name AS enterprise_name,
    p.party_id AS customer_id,
    ROUND(gt.total_guarantee_amount, 2) AS total_guarantee,
    ROUND(bt.total_loan_amount, 2) AS total_loan,
    ROUND(gt.total_guarantee_amount - bt.total_loan_amount, 2) AS guarantee_loan_gap
FROM borrower_totals bt
JOIN guarantor_totals gt ON gt.party_id = bt.party_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = bt.party_id
WHERE gt.total_guarantee_amount > bt.total_loan_amount
ORDER BY guarantee_loan_gap DESC, p.party_id;

SELECT pp.display_name AS employee_name, sm.staff_id, COUNT(ca.agreement_id) AS contract_count
FROM staff_member sm
JOIN party pp ON pp.party_id = sm.person_party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = sm.person_party_id
WHERE sm.employment_status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY sm.staff_id, pp.display_name
ORDER BY contract_count DESC, sm.staff_id;

SELECT pp.display_name AS 借款人姓名，pp.party_id AS 客户编号，
       ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS 本金余额合计，
       pr.annual_income AS 年收入，
       ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / pr.annual_income, 2) AS 倍数
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN party pp ON pp.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN person_profile pr ON pr.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE pp.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY pp.party_id, pp.display_name, pr.annual_income
HAVING SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / pr.annual_income > 2
ORDER BY 倍数 DESC, pp.party_id
LIMIT 200;

SELECT p.display_name AS staff_name,
       so.operator_id,
       so.authority_level,
       COUNT(ca.agreement_id) AS self_loan_count
FROM service_operator so
JOIN staff_member sm ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
JOIN party p ON sm.person_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE so.operator_kind = 'CREDIT_OFFICER'
  AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY so.operator_id, p.display_name, so.authority_level
ORDER BY self_loan_count DESC, so.operator_id;

SELECT p.display_name AS staff_name, ld.loan_id, ld.disbursed_amount, ld.disbursed_on
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ld.disbursement_account_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN staff_member sm ON sm.staff_id = ah.party_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = sm.person_party_id
WHERE ah.holder_role = 'OWNER'
  AND ah.effective_to IS NULL
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC, ld.loan_id;

WITH borrower_repayment AS (
    SELECT 
        p.party_id,
        SUM(rs.principal_due + rs.interest_due) AS total_repayment
    FROM repayment_schedule rs
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
    JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
    WHERE p.party_type = 'PERSON'
    GROUP BY p.party_id
)
SELECT 
    p.display_name AS 借款人姓名，
    p.party_id AS 借款人客户编号，
    pp.annual_income AS 个人年收入，
    ROUND(br.total_repayment, 2) AS 应还本息总额，
    ROUND(br.total_repayment * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS 占年收入倍数
FROM borrower_repayment br
JOIN party p ON br.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE pp.annual_income IS NOT NULL AND pp.annual_income > 0
ORDER BY 占年收入倍数 DESC, p.party_id ASC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT lpc.product_name_zh AS product_category,
       COUNT(*) AS overdue_installments,
       ROUND(SUM(dsn.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM delinquency_snapshot dsn
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = dsn.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN loan_product_catalog lpc ON lpc.product_code = ca.product_family
WHERE dsn.principal_overdue_days > 0
GROUP BY lpc.product_code, lpc.product_name_zh
ORDER BY total_overdue_principal DESC, lpc.product_name_zh;

WITH term_deposit_buckets AS (
    SELECT i.institution_id, i.institution_name, td.account_id, td.maturity_on,
           CASE
               WHEN td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30' THEN 'expired'
               WHEN julianday(td.maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') BETWEEN 0 AND 90 THEN 'within_90'
               ELSE 'over_90'
           END AS bucket
    FROM term_deposit td
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = td.account_id
    JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
    WHERE td.maturity_on IS NOT NULL
),
bucket_counts AS (
    SELECT institution_id, institution_name,
           SUM(CASE WHEN bucket = 'expired' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS expired_cnt,
           SUM(CASE WHEN bucket = 'within_90' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS within_90_cnt,
           SUM(CASE WHEN bucket = 'over_90' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS over_90_cnt
    FROM term_deposit_buckets
    GROUP BY institution_id, institution_name
)
SELECT institution_name,
       expired_cnt AS expired_count,
       within_90_cnt AS within_90_count,
       over_90_cnt AS over_90_count
FROM bucket_counts
WHERE expired_cnt >= 20
ORDER BY expired_cnt DESC, institution_name;

SELECT ou.org_unit_id AS 营业单元编号，
       ou.unit_name AS 营业单元名称，
       COUNT(*) AS 联合账户数量
FROM account a
JOIN account_holder ah ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = a.org_unit_id
GROUP BY a.account_id, ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ah.party_id) > 1
ORDER BY 联合账户数量 DESC, ou.org_unit_id;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id, 
    ou.unit_name, 
    COUNT(*) AS overdue_count, 
    ROUND(SUM(d.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM delinquency_snapshot d
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON d.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN account a ON ld.loan_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON a.org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE d.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY total_overdue_principal DESC, ou.unit_name;

SELECT 
    rs.loan_id,
    COUNT(*) AS overdue_installment_count,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM repayment_schedule rs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = rs.loan_id
WHERE rs.status != 'PAID'
  AND rs.due_date < date('now')
  AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY rs.loan_id
HAVING SUM(rs.principal_due) > 120000000
ORDER BY total_overdue_principal DESC, rs.loan_id;

SELECT i.institution_name, SUM(CASE WHEN rs.status != 'PAID' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdue_periods, SUM(CASE WHEN rs.status != 'PAID' THEN rs.interest_due ELSE 0.0 END) AS total_overdue_interest
FROM institution i
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE rs.status != 'PAID'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN rs.status != 'PAID' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 30
ORDER BY overdue_periods DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(*) AS overdue_loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 240
ORDER BY overdue_loan_count DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT loan_id, installment_no, principal_due, interest_due
FROM repayment_schedule
WHERE status != 'PAID' AND principal_due > 90000000
ORDER BY principal_due DESC, loan_id;

WITH credit_limit AS (
    SELECT institution_id, SUM(limit_amount) AS total_limit
    FROM credit_facility
    GROUP BY institution_id
),
loan_disbursement AS (
    SELECT cf.institution_id, SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN credit_facility cf ON cf.facility_id = ca.facility_id
    GROUP BY cf.institution_id
),
capital AS (
    SELECT institution_id, MAX(net_capital) AS net_cap
    FROM capital_snapshot
    GROUP BY institution_id
)
SELECT i.institution_name AS 机构名称，
       ROUND(cl.total_limit, 2) AS 授信额度合计，
       ROUND(ld.total_disbursed, 2) AS 发放金额合计，
       ROUND(c.net_cap, 2) AS 资本净额，
       ROUND(ld.total_disbursed * 1.0 / c.net_cap, 4) AS 发放对资本净额占比
FROM institution i
JOIN credit_limit cl ON cl.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN loan_disbursement ld ON ld.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN capital c ON c.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE ld.total_disbursed > c.net_cap
ORDER BY 发放对资本净额占比 DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT sa.security_id AS 担保合同编号，
       sa.secured_amount AS 设定担保金额，
       COUNT(DISTINCT gc.guarantor_party_id) AS 保证人个数，
       ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS 保证金额合计
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE sa.security_type = 'GUARANTEE'
  AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
HAVING SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) < sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY 保证金额合计 DESC, sa.security_id;

SELECT f.facility_id, f.limit_amount, sc.name_zh AS status_name
FROM credit_facility f
JOIN status_catalog sc ON sc.entity = 'CREDIT_FACILITY' AND sc.status_code = f.status
WHERE f.facility_type = 'REVOLVING'
ORDER BY f.limit_amount DESC, f.facility_id;

SELECT i.institution_name AS 机构名称, cf.facility_type AS 授信类型代码,
       ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount), 2) AS 授信限额合计
FROM credit_facility cf
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = cf.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_name, cf.facility_type
HAVING SUM(cf.limit_amount) > 2000000000
ORDER BY 授信限额合计 DESC, i.institution_name, cf.facility_type;

SELECT facility_type, COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM credit_facility
WHERE limit_amount > 300000000
GROUP BY facility_type
ORDER BY record_count DESC;

SELECT pm.payment_mode_name_zh, COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS record_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN payment_mode_catalog pm ON pm.payment_mode = ld.payment_mode
GROUP BY pm.payment_mode_name_zh
ORDER BY record_count DESC;

WITH ranked_products AS (
    SELECT product_id,
           actual_raise_amount,
           minimum_holding_days,
           NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY actual_raise_amount DESC) AS group_seq
    FROM wealth_product
    WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
      AND actual_raise_amount IS NOT NULL
),
group_stats AS (
    SELECT group_seq,
           COUNT(*) AS product_count
    FROM ranked_products
    WHERE minimum_holding_days > 0
    GROUP BY group_seq
    HAVING COUNT(*) BETWEEN 31 AND 33
)
SELECT group_seq,
       product_count
FROM group_stats
ORDER BY group_seq;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount), 2) AS 循环授信限额合计, COUNT(*) AS 发放笔数
FROM credit_facility cf
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.facility_id = cf.facility_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE cf.facility_type = '循环授信'
  AND ld.payment_mode = '受托支付'
ORDER BY 循环授信限额合计 DESC, 发放笔数 DESC;

SELECT pmc.payment_mode_name_zh AS 支付方式中文名称, COUNT(*) AS 待执行指令数量
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN payment_mode_catalog pmc ON pmc.payment_mode = pi.payment_mode
WHERE pi.status = '待执行'
GROUP BY pmc.payment_mode, pmc.payment_mode_name_zh
ORDER BY 待执行指令数量 DESC, pmc.payment_mode_name_zh;

SELECT itc.name_zh AS instrument_type_name, sc.name_zh AS status_name
FROM instrument_type_catalog itc
CROSS JOIN status_catalog sc
WHERE sc.entity = 'loan_drawdown'
ORDER BY itc.name_zh, sc.name_zh;

SELECT ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name, COUNT(*) AS manager_count
FROM staff_assignment sa
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = sa.org_unit_id
WHERE sa.role_code = 'CREDIT_MANAGER'
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY manager_count DESC, ou.org_unit_id;

SELECT d.loan_id, cg.grade_name_zh, d.principal_overdue_days, d.overdue_principal
FROM delinquency_snapshot d
JOIN risk_classification rc ON rc.loan_id = d.loan_id AND rc.as_of_date = d.as_of_date
JOIN classification_grade cg ON cg.grade_code = rc.grade_code
WHERE d.principal_overdue_days > 30 AND cg.is_nonperforming = 0
ORDER BY d.principal_overdue_days DESC, d.loan_id;

select i.institution_name, count(*) as 借据笔数
from loan_drawdown ld
join credit_agreement ca on ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
join institution i on i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
join provision_snapshot ps on ps.loan_id = ld.loan_id
where ps.provision_stage = 'STAGE_2'
  and ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount * 0.5
group by i.institution_name
order by 借据笔数 desc, i.institution_name

select i.institution_name, round(sum(ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount), 2) as 拨备缺口合计
from provision_snapshot ps
join loan_drawdown ld on ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
join credit_agreement ca on ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
join institution i on i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
where ps.required_amount > ps.recognized_amount
group by i.institution_name
order by 拨备缺口合计 desc, i.institution_name

SELECT a.account_id, a.account_subtype, ABS(COALESCE(bs.ledger_balance, 0)) AS book_balance
FROM account a
JOIN account_balance_snapshot bs ON bs.account_id = a.account_id
LEFT JOIN account_holder ah_secondary ON ah_secondary.account_id = a.account_id 
    AND ah_secondary.holder_role != 'PRIMARY'
WHERE a.status = 'DORMANT' 
    AND a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
    AND ah_secondary.account_holder_id IS NULL
ORDER BY book_balance DESC, a.account_id;

SELECT p.customer_segment AS 客户分层，
       COUNT(*) AS 客户数量
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE pp.annual_income > 1000000
GROUP BY p.customer_segment
ORDER BY 客户数量 DESC, 客户分层 ASC;

SELECT ma.asset_category_primary,
       COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM managed_asset ma
WHERE ma.asset_scope = 'TRUSTEE_MANAGED'
  AND ma.industry_code IN (
    SELECT s.sector_code
    FROM industry_sector s
    WHERE s.risk_category = 'RESTRICTED'
  )
GROUP BY ma.asset_category_primary
HAVING COUNT(*) < 33
ORDER BY cnt DESC, ma.asset_category_primary;

SELECT p.party_id AS 客户编号，
       pp.annual_income AS 年收入，
       SUM(cf.limit_amount) AS 授信额度合计，
       ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS 偿债比
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN credit_facility cf ON cf.obligor_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'PERSON'
  AND pp.annual_income IS NOT NULL
  AND pp.annual_income > 0
GROUP BY p.party_id, pp.annual_income
HAVING SUM(cf.limit_amount) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income > 3
ORDER BY 偿债比 DESC, 客户编号
LIMIT 10;

SELECT pp.occupation_code,
       pp.employment_sector,
       COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY pp.occupation_code, pp.employment_sector
ORDER BY customer_count DESC, pp.occupation_code, pp.employment_sector;

SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM payment_card
JOIN card_type_catalog c ON payment_card.card_type = c.card_type
WHERE c.name_zh = '借记卡'
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY card_count DESC, status;

SELECT ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
       ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS total_amount
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = pe.from_account_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
   AND ah.effective_from <= pe.business_date
   AND (ah.effective_to IS NULL OR ah.effective_to > pe.business_date)
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ah.party_id
JOIN staff_member sm ON sm.person_party_id = p.party_id
   AND sm.employment_status = 'ACTIVE'
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = sm.home_org_unit_id
WHERE a.account_kind = 'CREDIT_CARD_SETTLEMENT'
  AND pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY total_amount DESC, ou.unit_name;

SELECT pe.payment_id,
       pc.card_id,
       pc.holder_party_id,
       pe.business_date,
       pe.amount
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN payment_card pc ON pc.settlement_account_id = pe.from_account_id
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC, pe.payment_id ASC, pc.card_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT pc.holder_party_id AS 持卡人编号，
       COUNT(*) AS 现金交易笔数，
       ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS 金额合计
FROM payment_card pc
JOIN payment_event pe ON pe.from_account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY pc.holder_party_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 5
ORDER BY 现金交易笔数 DESC, 金额合计 DESC, pc.holder_party_id;

SELECT holder_party_id, COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM payment_card
GROUP BY holder_party_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 3
ORDER BY card_count DESC, holder_party_id;

SELECT ct.name_zh AS card_type_name,
       COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
       ROUND(AVG(pe.amount), 2) AS avg_single_amount
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN payment_card pc ON pc.card_id = pe.operator_id
JOIN card_type_catalog ct ON ct.card_type = pc.card_type
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
  AND pc.card_type IN ('CREDIT_CARD', 'DEBIT_CARD')
GROUP BY pc.card_type, ct.name_zh
ORDER BY avg_single_amount DESC, ct.name_zh ASC;

SELECT pe.channel,
       COUNT(*) AS txn_cnt,
       ROUND(AVG(pe.amount), 2) AS avg_amt
FROM payment_event pe
WHERE pe.status = 'SETTLED'
  AND pe.is_cash = 0
GROUP BY pe.channel
HAVING AVG(pe.amount) > 11780000
ORDER BY avg_amt DESC, pe.channel;

SELECT a.account_id, td.maturity_on, a.status
FROM account a
JOIN term_deposit td ON td.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE td.maturity_on IS NOT NULL
  AND td.maturity_on < DATE('now')
  AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY td.maturity_on DESC, a.account_id
LIMIT 200;

SELECT ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label, MAX(cv.valuation_amount) AS max_valuation
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN collateral_valuation cv ON cv.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
GROUP BY ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label
HAVING COUNT(cv.valuation_id) >= 2
ORDER BY max_valuation DESC, ca.collateral_id;

select 
  ca.collateral_id as 押品编号，
  ca.asset_label as 押品标识，
  count(*) as 押品被引用次数，
  count(distinct cl.security_id) as 关联的不同担保合同数
from collateral_link cl
join collateral_asset ca on ca.collateral_id = cl.collateral_id
where cl.status = 'ACTIVE' and ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
group by ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label
having count(*) >= 2
order by 押品被引用次数 desc, 押品编号;

WITH loan_totals AS (
  SELECT ca.agreement_id, SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed
  FROM credit_agreement ca
  JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
  WHERE ld.status != 'CLOSED' OR ld.closed_on IS NULL
  GROUP BY ca.agreement_id
),
guarantee_links AS (
  SELECT so.agreement_id, gc.guarantor_party_id, gc.guaranteed_amount
  FROM secured_obligation so
  JOIN security_agreement sa ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
  JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
  WHERE so.agreement_id IS NOT NULL
    AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND (gc.effective_to IS NULL OR gc.effective_to > date('now'))
)
SELECT 
  g.guarantor_party_id AS 保证人客户编号，
  p.display_name AS 保证人名称，
  g.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号，
  ROUND(g.guaranteed_amount, 2) AS 保证承诺金额，
  ROUND(l.total_disbursed, 2) AS 合同实际放款总金额
FROM guarantee_links g
JOIN loan_totals l ON l.agreement_id = g.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = g.guarantor_party_id
WHERE g.guaranteed_amount > l.total_disbursed
ORDER BY g.guaranteed_amount DESC, g.guarantor_party_id ASC, g.agreement_id ASC;

select so.agreement_id, round(sum(so.covered_amount), 2) as total_covered
  from secured_obligation so
  join security_agreement sa on sa.security_id = so.security_id
  where sa.status = 'ACTIVE' and so.effective_to is null
  group by so.agreement_id
)
select ca.agreement_id, ca.borrower_party_id as 债务人编号，ca.contract_amount as 授信合同金额，
  gc.total_covered as 担保覆盖合计，round(ca.contract_amount - gc.total_covered, 2) as 保障缺口
from credit_agreement ca
join 担保覆盖合计 gc on gc.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
where ca.status = 'ACTIVE' and ca.effective_to is null
  and ca.contract_amount > gc.total_covered
order by 保障缺口 desc, ca.agreement_id
limit 100

select i.institution_name, cg.grade_name_zh, count(*) as 借据笔数
from loan_drawdown ld
join risk_classification rc on rc.loan_id = ld.loan_id
join classification_grade cg on cg.grade_code = rc.grade_code
join provision_snapshot ps on ps.loan_id = ld.loan_id
join institution inst on inst.institution_id = ld.institution_id
join institution i on i.institution_id = inst.institution_id
where cg.grade_name_zh = '次级'
  and ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
  and rc.as_of_date = (
    select max(rc2.as_of_date)
    from risk_classification rc2
    where rc2.loan_id = rc.loan_id
  )
  and ps.as_of_date = (
    select max(ps2.as_of_date)
    from provision_snapshot ps2
    where ps2.loan_id = ps.loan_id
  )
group by i.institution_name, cg.grade_name_zh
order by 借据笔数 desc, i.institution_name

select 
    ca.borrower_party_id as 债务人编号，
    ld.loan_id as 借据编号，
    lbs.principal_balance as 贷款余额，
    ca.contract_amount as 授信金额，
    round(lbs.principal_balance * 1.0 / ca.contract_amount, 2) as 余额倍数
from loan_drawdown ld
join credit_agreement ca on ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
join loan_balance_snapshot lbs on lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
where lbs.principal_balance >= ca.contract_amount * 4.0
  and lbs.as_of_date = (
      select max(as_of_date) 
      from loan_balance_snapshot 
      where loan_id = ld.loan_id
  )
order by 余额倍数 desc, ld.loan_id;

select i.institution_name, cg.grade_name_zh, count(*) as 多计提笔数,
  round(sum(ps.recognized_amount - ps.required_amount), 2) as 多计提金额合计
from provision_snapshot ps
join loan_drawdown ld on ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
join credit_agreement ca on ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
join institution i on i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
join risk_classification rc on rc.loan_id = ld.loan_id and rc.as_of_date = ps.as_of_date
join classification_grade cg on cg.grade_code = rc.grade_code
where cg.is_nonperforming = 1
  and ps.recognized_amount > ps.required_amount
group by i.institution_name, cg.grade_name_zh
order by 多计提金额合计 desc, i.institution_name, cg.grade_name_zh

SELECT 
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN cv.appraiser_kind = 'INTERNAL' THEN cv.valuation_amount END), 2) AS max_internal_value,
    ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN cv.appraiser_kind = 'EXTERNAL' THEN cv.valuation_amount END),! 2) AS max_external_value,
    ROUND(
        MAX(CASE WHEN cv.appraiser_kind = 'INTERNAL' THEN cv.valuation_amount END) - 
        MAX(CASE WHEN cv.appraiser_kind = 'EXTERNAL' THEN cv.valuation_amount END), 
        2
    ) AS undervaluation_diff
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN collateral_valuation cv ON cv.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE cv.appraiser_kind IN ('INTERNAL', 'EXTERNAL')
GROUP BY ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label
HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN cv.appraiser_kind = 'INTERNAL' THEN cv.valuation_amount END) IS NOT NULL
   AND MAX(CASE WHEN cv.appraiser_kind = 'EXTERNAL' THEN cv.valuation_amount END) IS NOT NULL
   AND MAX(CASE WHEN cv.appraiser_kind = 'INTERNAL' THEN cv.valuation_amount END) > 
       MAX(CASE WHEN cv.appraiser_kind = 'EXTERNAL' THEN cv.valuation_amount END)
ORDER BY undervaluation_diff DESC, ca.collateral_id;

SELECT ca.collateral_id,
       ca.asset_label,
       cv.valuation_amount AS latest_valuation,
       SUM(cl.pledged_amount) AS total_pledged,
       ROUND(SUM(cl.pledged_amount) - cv.valuation_amount, 2) AS gap
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN collateral_valuation cv ON cv.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
JOIN collateral_link cl ON cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
JOIN (
    SELECT collateral_id, MAX(valued_on) AS max_valued_on
    FROM collateral_valuation
    GROUP BY collateral_id
) latest_cv ON latest_cv.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id AND latest_cv.max_valued_on = cv.valued_on
WHERE cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label, cv.valuation_amount
HAVING SUM(cl.pledged_amount) > cv.valuation_amount
ORDER BY gap DESC, ca.collateral_id;

SELECT 
    gc.guarantor_party_id AS 保证人编号，
    p.display_name AS 保证人名称，
    ROUND(SUM(l_self.disbursed_amount), 2) AS 自身借款金额合计，
    ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS 对外保证金额合计
FROM guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
JOIN secured_obligation so ON so.security_id = gc.security_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca_guarantee ON ca_guarantee.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
-- 连接保证人自己的借款
JOIN credit_agreement ca_borrow ON ca_borrow.borrower_party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown l_self ON l_self.agreement_id = ca_borrow.agreement_id

SELECT 
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount,
    COUNT(gc.guarantor_party_id) AS guarantor_count,

GROUP BY sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount

SELECT p.customer_segment,

SELECT p.party_id AS 主体编号，p.display_name AS 主体名称，
       COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_id) AS 关联关系条数，
       COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS 借款合同笔数

JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id

GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pr.re!relation_id) > 0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) > 0
ORDER BY 关联关系条数 DESC, p.party_id;

SELECT p.party_id,
       p.display_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) AS group_count
FROM party p
JOIN party_relation pr ON (pr.source_party_id = p.party_id OR pr.target_party_id = p.party_id)

WHERE pr.relation_type = 'SHADOW_SHAREHOLDER'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name

SELECT pr.relation_id, pr.source_party_id, pr.target_party_id,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ld1.loan_id) AS source_loan_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ld2.loan_id) AS target_loan_count
FROM party_relation pr
JOIN loan_drawdown ld1 ON ld1.agreement_id IN (
    SELECT ca.agreement_id FROM credit_agreement ca WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = pr.source_party_id
)
JOIN loan_drawdown ld2 ON ld2.agreement_id IN (
    SELECT ca.agreement_id FROM credit_agreement ca WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = pr.target_party_id
)

  AND pr.effective_to IS NULL
GROUP BY pr.relation_id, pr.source_party_id, pr.target_party_id
ORDER BY (source_loan_count + target_loan_count) DESC, pr.relation_id;

WITH guarantor_exposure AS (
    SELECT 
        gc.guarantor_party_id,
        SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS total_guarantee
    FROM guarantor_commitment gc
    WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
      AND (gc.effective_to IS NULL OR gc.effective_to > datetime('now'))
    GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id
),
borrower_exposure AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_loan_balance
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs2 
        WHERE lbs2.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    )
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
)
SELECT 
    p.party_id AS 保证人编号，
    p.display_name AS 保证人名称，
    ROUND(ge.total_guarantee, 2) AS 有效保证责任合计，
    ROUND(COALESCE(be.total_loan_balance, 0.0), 2) AS 自身贷款金额，
    ROUND(ge.total_guarantee - COALESCE(be.total_loan_balance, 0.0), 2) AS 超额担保金额
FROM party p
JOIN guarantor_exposure ge ON ge.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
LEFT JOIN borrower_exposure be ON be.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE ge.total_guarantee > COALESCE(be.total_loan_balance, 0.0)
ORDER BY 超额担保金额 DESC, p.party_id;

WITH overdue_borrowers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.party_id
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.overdue_principal > 0
),
guarantors_with_overdue AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT gc.guarantor_party_id
    FROM guarantor_commitment gc
    JOIN security_agreement sa ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
    JOIN secured_obligation so ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE p.party_id IN (SELECT party_id FROM overdue_borrowers)
      AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
)
SELECT 
    gc.guarantor_party_id AS 保证人编号，
    p.display_name AS 保证人名称，
    ROUND(gc.guaranteed_amount, 2) AS 保证金额，
    gc.status AS 保证状态
FROM guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN party p ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE gc.guarantor_party_id IN (SELECT guarantor_party_id FROM guarantors_with_overdue)
  AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY gc.guaranteed_amount DESC, gc.guarantor_party_id ASC;

SELECT wp.product_name,
       ma.asset_name,
       mo.obligor_party_id,
       SUM(CASE WHEN ds.overdue_principal > 0 THEN ds.overdue_principal ELSE 0 END) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON ma.asset_id = phs.asset_id
JOIN private_credit_profile pcp ON pcp.asset_id = ma.asset_id
